title: Lumpcode daemon config file
description: Schema for committed `.lumpcode/daemons/<daemonId>.{json,yml,yaml}` recipes. The daemon id is the file stem only — do not put `daemonId` in the file. Dedicated supervise considers a file when its `discoveryBranch` equals the dedicated line's `effectiveDiscoveryBranch` (the `origin/<branch>` ref the file was read from). See DOCS/concepts.md.

discoveryBranch.description: Exact expanded primary this recipe applies to. Must equal the dedicated line's effectiveDiscoveryBranch (the origin ref the file was read from). Globs (* or ?) are not allowed.

cronSetup.description: Cron expression for daemon ticks. Omit to use the CLI default (*/5 * * * *).

include.description: Lump-name include filter (* globs allowed). Omit or [] for all loadable lumps (same as unfiltered start).

exclude.description: Lump-name exclude filter (* globs allowed). Omit or [] for no excludes.

disabled.description: When true, supervise stops (or does not start) this file-launched daemon. Default false.

maxParallelRun.description: Maximum concurrent lump runs per tick when workspaceStrategy is worktree. Same meaning as `lumpcode start --maxParallelRun`. Omit to use the supervise-start local.json default. Invalid with checkout strategy (supervise will not start that id).
